scope: Actual product browser assets against invented GET-only loopback metadata. Historical title and requirement binding only; no real candidate, container, provider, corpus or human exercise.
behavior: Terminal titles, run-picker labels and requirement text use only saved evidence whose run projection, version, mode, task identity and archive pin match the recorded run.
Evidence integrity remains the existing server responsibility; frontend contains no duplicate canonical digest or historical policy formula.
Pending or mismatched context retains recorded IDs/statuses and coverage counts, withholds saved text/download and supports GET-only retry.
Running catalogue context requires matching source and policy pins. Comparison denominators are recorded coverage length, with recorded task titles shown on cards.
Metadata readiness gates addressed-run fetch, context binding, streams and mutation controls before capability/archival pins arrive.
